capabilities: Render a week timeline of Shadow meetings as a Bases view
Show people cards with meeting counts and last-met dates
Display meeting context for the open person or meeting page
Add links to today's meetings in the daily note
List all meetings in a sidebar grouped by date
disambiguation: Not a meeting recorder; the plugin records and transcribes nothing itself and only displays meetings captured by the Shadow Mac app.
extras: Desktop only and macOS only, because the Shadow app it depends on runs on Apple Silicon Macs. The plugin itself is free, makes no network requests, and never edits the pages Shadow manages; AI notes in Shadow require a paid plan ($12/month or $8/month yearly), but the plugin works the same on the free plan.
problem: Meeting pages an external recorder writes into the vault are plain Markdown, with no week calendar, per-person history, or quick links to transcripts and notes.

relations.evidence: Requires the Shadow Mac app (Apple Silicon, macOS 14.2 or later), which records meetings without a bot
a link to each of today's meetings under a Meetings heading in today's daily note (core Daily notes or Periodic Notes)

summary: Bases views and sidebar panels for meetings recorded by the Shadow Mac app: a week timeline, people cards, per-page meeting context, and daily note links.
